Constitutional neutropenia and immunoglobulin deficiency with recurrent infections; osteoporosis, fractures and osseous anomalies are defining features.

Primary breast lobular carcinoma; breast lies outside the axes, and metastases are not inherent to the concept.
Purely psychiatric anxiety and depressive disorder without defining damage to any organ axis.
Refractory plasma-cell cancer is predominantly myeloma: bone destruction in most and disease-related renal impairment in ~30-50%; treatment toxicity is excluded.
Presynaptic NMJ disease; ptosis/ophthalmoparesis 5/5 and arthrogryposis 2/5. Apnea and dysphagia reflect neuromuscular failure rather than intrinsic lung or gut injury.
